name: Queen of Pain Announcer × Dota 2 Killstreaks
creator: dear-agony
description:
### Overview

A custom Queen of Pain announcer based on The Eminence of Ristul, featuring adapted announcer events and classic Dota 2 killstreak and multikill announcements.

Voice lines were adjusted and remapped to better fit League's announcer system.

---

### Queen of Pain announcements

*(original League announcements → Queen of Pain voice lines)*

**General**

• Welcome to Summoner's Rift →  Hello there.      
• 30 seconds to minions spawn → Shall we begin?           
• Minions have spawned → So begins the reign of pain.        

• Summoner disconnected → Too bad.            
• Summoner reconnected → Now we're talking.     

• Victory → Victory!      
• Defeat → Defeated!     

**Objectives**

• Your team destroyed a turret → A path to pain.       
• Your team destroyed an inhibitor → This one is so in the bag.      

• Your turret destroyed → Such impudence.      
• Your inhibitor destroyed → It must be torture.       

• Your inhibitor respawn → Your pain ends.      
• Your inhibitor respawning soon → Torturous anticipation.       

• Enemy inhibitor respawn → There's harm to be done.       
• Enemy inhibitor respawning soon → Proper torture cannot be rushed.      

**Combat**

• Ally slain → Ah, poor things. / Despair.        
• Enemy slain → Oh yes. / Sweet pain. / Delightful.       

• You have slain an enemy → Oh my. / That was perfect. / More. More.       
• You have been slain → Let's die a little. / Noo!       

• Shutdown → That didn't last long. / Unsatisfying.       
• Executed → Denied.            
• Ace → The ecstasy of agony. / Exquisite agony.     

### Dota 2 killstreak & multikill announcements

*(original League announcements → Dota 2 replacements)*

**Multikills**

• First Blood → First Blood!      
• Double Kill → Double Kill!      
• Triple Kill → Triple Kill!      
• Quadra Kill → Ultra Kill!      
• Penta Kill → Rampage!     

**Killstreaks**

• Killing Spree → Killing Spree!     
• Rampage → Mega Kill!      

*(Dota 2 Rampage was intentionally NOT used here because in Dota 2 it represents a Pentakill-equivalent killstreak rather than a regular streak tier.)*    

• Dominating → Dominating!      
• Unstoppable → Unstoppable!      
• Godlike → Godlike! / Monster Kill!      
• Legendary → Ownage! / Holy Shit! / Wicked Sick!
